source.adaptation: concept/rule delta only; no framework/package copied

rules.finding: Gradient-filled text is used as decorative emphasis.
rules.rationale: Mechanical AI-design tell with legibility/theming risk; solid text color preserves hierarchy without decorative fill.
falsePositiveGuards: Do not flag non-text decorative surfaces.
Do not flag when background-clip is not text.

rules.finding: Large blurred chromatic glow is used as default surface decoration.
rules.rationale: Unbounded glow often creates design-system drift and can reduce visual clarity; purposeful state/status glows remain allowed.
falsePositiveGuards: Allow tiny status/live indicators documented by DESIGN.md.
Allow focus/accessibility rings and transient interaction feedback.
Advisory only unless approved design evidence explicitly forbids glow.

rules.finding: A narrow chromatic stripe is used as a decorative card/list side tab.
rules.rationale: Decorative side stripes are a recurring generic UI shortcut and should not replace product-specific hierarchy.
falsePositiveGuards: Skip navigation, progress, slider, scrollbar, separator, tablist and status contexts.
Skip intentional active-state indicator when backed by approved design evidence.
